about: Recipes for riders, written for this app in our own words (not copied from any cookbook or website). Every ingredient is a knowledge/foods.json id. Amounts are g, ml for drinks, or count for whole foods like eggs. Macros, diet tags and allergens are computed from the ingredients by metrics/recipes.py and are never typed here. A swap replaces one ingredient with the foods in its with list (an empty list means leave it out).

recipes.name: Overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds and maple syrup together in a jar.
Cover and leave in the fridge overnight, or at least 4 hours.
Top with the blueberries in the morning. Loosen with a splash of milk if it's too thick.
recipes.why: Ready the moment you wake up, with slow carbs from the oats and protein from the yogurt to start the day.

swaps.text: Use soy milk for dairy free or vegan
Use soy yogurt for dairy free or vegan

recipes.name: Banana oat pancakes
steps: Blend the oats to a coarse flour.
Add the bananas, eggs, milk and cinnamon and blend until smooth. Rest 5 minutes so it thickens.
Melt a little butter in a pan over medium heat and pour in small rounds of batter.
Flip when bubbles show on top, about 2 minutes a side.
Serve with the maple syrup.
recipes.why: A big carb breakfast that sits lighter than it looks, and the cooked pancakes freeze for rushed mornings.

swaps.text: Use 2 tbsp ground flaxseed in 6 tbsp water for the eggs
Use soy milk for dairy free or vegan
Use canola oil in the pan

recipes.name: Rice porridge with maple and fruit
steps: Simmer the rice in 300 ml water until most of the water is gone, about 12 minutes.
Add the milk, cinnamon and raisins and simmer gently, stirring often, until creamy, about 12 minutes more.
Stir in the maple syrup and top with sliced banana.
recipes.why: Low in fibre and easy on the stomach, so it suits an early start before a hard or long ride.

swaps.text: Use soy milk for dairy free or vegan

recipes.name: Bagel with jam and a banana smoothie
steps: Toast the bagel and spread with jam.
Blend the banana, strawberries and milk until smooth.
recipes.why: Lots of quick carbs in a few minutes, about 2 to 3 hours before a ride.

swaps.text: Use soy milk for dairy free
Use honey for jam

recipes.name: Savoury rice and egg bowl
steps: Warm the rice in a pan with the oil.
Push it to one side, crack in the eggs and fry or scramble them.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Season with the soy sauce and scatter over the sesame seeds.
recipes.why: A savoury start for riders who don't like sweet breakfasts, using rice cooked the day before.

swaps.text: Use crumbled firm tofu for eggs
swaps.name: Savoury rice and tofu bowl

swaps.text: Use a pinch of salt for soy sauce (or a gluten free tamari)
Leave out the sesame seeds

recipes.name: Sweet rice cakes with dates
steps: Cook the rice in 600 ml water, covered, until soft and sticky. Short grain or sushi rice holds together best.
Chop the dates and stir them in with the maple syrup, cinnamon and salt while the rice is hot.
Press firmly into a lined tray about 2 cm deep and let it cool.
Cut into 12 squares and wrap each in foil or paper.
recipes.why: Real food carbs that are easy to chew on the bike, with a little salt for longer rides.

recipes.name: Savoury rice cakes with egg
steps: Cook the rice in 600 ml water, covered, until soft and sticky.
Scramble the eggs in the oil and break them into small pieces.
Mix the eggs, soy sauce and salt through the rice.
Press into a lined tray about 2 cm deep, cool, then cut into 12 squares and wrap.
recipes.why: A salty break from sweet food on long days, with a little protein.

swaps.text: Use crumbled firm tofu for eggs
swaps.name: Savoury rice cakes with tofu

swaps.text: Use a pinch more salt for soy sauce (or a gluten free tamari)

recipes.name: Banana bread
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and line a loaf tin.
Mash the bananas well, then beat in the eggs, oil and sugar.
Fold in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt until just mixed.
Bake 50 to 55 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean. Cool before slicing into 10.
recipes.why: Dense and moist, so a wrapped slice survives a jersey pocket. Slices freeze well for the week.

swaps.text: Use 2 tbsp ground flaxseed in 6 tbsp water for the eggs

recipes.name: Oat and date energy balls
steps: Blend the dates to a sticky paste. Soak them in hot water for 10 minutes first if they're dry.
Add the oats, peanut butter, cocoa, chia seeds and salt and pulse until it holds together.
Roll into 12 balls and chill for 30 minutes.
recipes.why: No baking, and they keep a week, so there's always something to grab before a ride.

swaps.text: Use tahini for peanut butter
Use cinnamon for cocoa
Leave out the chia seeds

recipes.name: Jam sandwich squares
steps: Spread jam thinly on two slices and close the sandwiches.
Trim the crusts if you like, cut each sandwich into 4 squares, and wrap in foil.
recipes.why: Cheap, quick and gentle on the stomach. White bread has little fibre, which helps when riding hard.

swaps.text: Use honey for jam

recipes.name: Baked sweet potato bites
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into bite size cubes and toss with the oil, maple syrup, salt and cinnamon.
Roast 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until soft with caramel edges.
Cool, then pack in a small bag or foil.
recipes.why: A salty sweet real food option with no gluten, for riders who tire of bars.

recipes.name: Chocolate milk
steps: Drink within about an hour of finishing, with a meal to follow later.
recipes.why: Carbs, protein and fluid in one bottle, ready the moment you get home.

swaps.text: Use soy chocolate milk for dairy free or vegan
swaps.name: Soy chocolate milk

recipes.name: Homemade chocolate milk
steps: Stir the cocoa and sugar with a splash of warm milk to a smooth paste.
Whisk in the rest of the milk. Shake in a bottle if you're taking it with you.
recipes.why: The same recovery drink for less money, and you choose the sweetness.

swaps.text: Use soy milk for dairy free or vegan

recipes.name: Recovery smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender and blend until smooth. Add more milk if it's too thick.
recipes.why: Easy to get down when you're not hungry after a hard ride, with carbs and protein together.

swaps.text: Use soy yogurt for dairy free or vegan
Use soy milk for dairy free or vegan
Use maple syrup for honey

recipes.name: Greek yogurt bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, the blueberries, a drizzle of honey and the pumpkin seeds.
recipes.why: A high protein bowl for after rides, with fruit to refill carbs.

swaps.text: Use soy yogurt for dairy free or vegan
swaps.name: Soy yogurt bowl

swaps.text: Use maple syrup for honey
Leave out the seeds

recipes.name: Scrambled eggs on toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat, add the beaten eggs and stir slowly until just set.
Fold in the spinach at the end and season.
recipes.why: Quick protein after a ride. Add a glass of juice or a banana on big days for more carbs.

swaps.text: Scramble 150 g crumbled firm tofu instead of eggs
swaps.name: Scrambled tofu on toast

swaps.text: Use olive oil for butter

recipes.name: Burrito bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the chicken, pepper and onion. Fry in the oil with the cumin, paprika and salt until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the beans in a small pan.
Dice the tomato and avocado.
Build bowls with rice, beans, the chicken mix, tomato and avocado.
recipes.why: Rice and beans give plenty of carbs, and everything except the avocado packs well for lunch the next day.

swaps.text: Use firm tofu for chicken

recipes.name: Lentil and tomato curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cooked lentils and simmer 15 minutes, adding water if it gets thick.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season, and serve over the rice.
recipes.why: Cheap, filling and full of carbs and plant protein. It tastes better the next day.

recipes.name: Tomato pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cook the pasta 2 minutes short of the packet time.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the pasta and spinach, tip into a baking dish and top with the mozzarella.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling.
recipes.why: A big tray of carbs that reheats well, so the night before a long ride is already sorted.

swaps.text: Use cooked lentils for beef
Leave out the cheese

recipes.name: Chicken or tofu stir fry with rice noodles
steps: Soak or boil the noodles as the packet says, then drain.
Stir fry the sliced chicken in the oil over high heat until cooked, then set aside.
Stir fry the vegetables for 4 minutes so they keep some bite.
Mix the soy sauce, garlic, ginger and maple syrup, then toss everything together with the noodles.
recipes.why: Quick on a weeknight, with lean protein and noodles that digest easily.

swaps.text: Use firm tofu for chicken
Use salt and a little more maple for soy sauce (or a gluten free tamari)

recipes.name: Chickpea and potato traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (410°F).
Cut the potatoes into chunks and toss on a big tray with the oil, paprika, cumin and salt. Roast 20 minutes.
Add the drained chickpeas and sliced pepper and onion, toss, and roast 20 minutes more.
Serve with spoonfuls of yogurt.
recipes.why: One tray, little washing up, and lots of carbs from the potatoes.

swaps.text: Use soy yogurt, or leave it out

recipes.name: Salmon with rice and greens
steps: Cook the rice.
Rub the salmon with half the oil and roast at 200°C (400°F) for 12 to 15 minutes.
Steam the broccoli for 5 minutes and wilt the spinach in the remaining oil.
Drizzle the soy sauce and lemon juice over the salmon and greens and serve with the rice.
recipes.why: Protein and omega 3 fats from the salmon, with rice to refill after training.

swaps.text: Use tempeh for salmon
swaps.name: Tempeh with rice and greens
swaps.why: Protein from the tempeh, with rice to refill after training.

swaps.text: Use a pinch of salt for soy sauce (or a gluten free tamari)

recipes.name: Bean chilli with rice
steps: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, cocoa and salt and simmer 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Cook the rice while it simmers, and serve together.
recipes.why: Makes four big portions that freeze well, with carbs and plant protein in every bowl.

swaps.text: Leave out the cocoa

recipes.name: Gnocchi with tomato and white beans
steps: Warm the garlic in the oil for a minute, add the tomatoes and salt, and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the drained beans and the spinach.
Boil the gnocchi until they float, drain, and fold into the sauce.
Tear the mozzarella over the top and let it melt.
recipes.why: A fast carb dinner from the cupboard, ready in about 25 minutes.

swaps.text: Leave out the cheese

recipes.name: Hummus and pitta with crunchy veg
steps: Warm the pitta and cut into strips.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into sticks and dip everything in the hummus.
recipes.why: A filling snack between rides without much fuss.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with mango
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl, top with the mango and drizzle with honey.
recipes.why: A protein snack that suits the evening, and some riders use it before bed.

swaps.text: Use maple syrup for honey

recipes.name: Salted edamame
steps: Boil or microwave the frozen edamame for 4 to 5 minutes.
Drain and toss with the salt and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.why: A plant protein snack that's ready in five minutes.

recipes.name: Trail mix
steps: Mix everything in a jar and shake. A small handful is one serving.
recipes.why: Energy dense, so it's handy on busy days when meals run late.

swaps.text: Use sunflower seeds for almonds

recipes.name: Seed and raisin mix
steps: Toast the seeds in a dry pan for 3 minutes if you like, cool, and mix with the raisins.
recipes.why: A trail mix without whole nuts. Seeds are often packed beside nuts, so check the label if you avoid them.

recipes.name: Peanut butter and banana toast
steps: Toast the bread, spread thinly with peanut butter, top with sliced banana and a little honey.
recipes.why: A small pre ride snack, about 60 to 90 minutes before you go, with only a little fat.

swaps.text: Use maple syrup for honey

recipes.name: Salted baby potatoes
steps: Boil small potatoes in their skins until just tender, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain, toss with the salt while warm, cool, and pack in a small bag.
recipes.why: Plain carbs and salt with almost no fat or fibre. Kind to the stomach on long, hot rides.
